description: The same as it08-03, with the functions in a header file (the same example on the Mega 2560).
basis: the output of the example on the Uno (class derived: derived by hand from the sketch source (C++ semantics, avr-gcc: int is 16 bit) and the 'Beobachtung' comment of the example; A0..A2 are pins 14..16) holds for the Mega 2560 except for the pin numbers the sketch prints: A0, A1 and A2 are the Arduino pins 54, 55 and 56 there (pins_arduino.h of the mega variant: A0 = 54) instead of 14, 15 and 16, so 'Stelle 14/15/16' becomes 'Stelle 54/55/56'; nothing else differs (16 MHz, 16-bit int, same core 1.8.8); no recording on a Mega exists
